cuts.head: with_body
cuts.placeText: a computer repair shop — opened desktop towers, a workbench with tiny screwdrivers, shelves of circuit boards and a magnifying lamp
cuts.scene: she is an apprentice sitting on a stool picking at a tiny circuit part on the bench
cuts.outfit: a computer technician look fitted to her body — a short sleeveless work vest over a fitted tank top and short shorts, bare shoulders and legs, a plain magnet-shaped hairpin
